entries: 🎃 Halloween event is live until November 3rd!
🍹 Three new recipes in the shop: Pumpkin Spice Latte, Vampire's Kiss and Ghost Milk Tea
🧙 A new secret recipe is hiding somewhere — brew it before the event ends
🧊 Customers now order ice. Some want it, some refuse it, so check the ticket
🧋 Customers can now ask for tapioca pearls
📋 Menu expanded from 16 to 41 drinks, including White Milk Tea and Vanilla Milk Tea
🍦 Vanilla powder now shows up in customer orders
❄️ Winter recipes are now properly out of season and return December 1st
🎄 Gingerbread Milk Tea, North Pole Peppermint Latte and Golden Countdown will be back this winter
Fixed customers rejecting a correct drink if you owned a secret recipe made from the same ingredients
Fixed secret recipes not being added to your collection when you discovered them
Secret recipe orders now appear based on how rare each recipe is
Official release of our game
Introduced new theme: City 🏙️
Existing bug fixes
🥐 Food items to order. Unlock the kitchen to access.

Removed winter overlay
Patched bug (potentially) for claiming HONEYMATCHA code
